franklin.name: Franklin
franklin.commentary: As of May 31, 2026, Franklin has 3.3 months of supply, which is a seller's market, down from 4.1 three months earlier and up from 2.6 a year earlier. murfreesboro.commentary: As of May 31, 2026, Murfreesboro has 3.7 months of supply, which is a seller's market, down from 4.5 three months earlier and unchanged from a year ago.
